assumptions.flops_efficiency: Effective fraction of peak dense tensor FLOPS. Not a measured constant; varies by kernel, shape and version.
assumptions.memory_efficiency: Effective fraction of peak HBM bandwidth. Not a measured constant.
assumptions.communication: Ring all-reduce approximation with a fixed per-collective latency; topology and overlap are simplified.
assumptions.cpu_overhead: Per-step and per-sequence approximations. vLLM version, streaming, detokenization and sampling matter.
assumptions.attention: KV reads and attention FLOPs are modeled; backend-specific paged/flash kernels and CUDA graphs are not cycle-simulated.
assumptions.quantization: Reduced weight/KV bytes are represented; kernel-specific quantization speedup is not automatically assumed.
